definitions.meaning: Going into a monastery, entering on a monastic life

quotations.old_english: Heó ðonne mót gif heó wile ðæt forlǽtan and hyre mynstergang geceósan
quotations.latin: tunc, si velit, licebit ei id derelinquere, et vitam monasticam sibi eligere

source_text: mynster-gang, es; m. Going into a monastery, entering on a monastic life :-- Heó ðonne mót gif heó wile ðæt forlǽtan and hyre mynstergang geceósan tunc, si velit, licebit ei id derelinquere, et vitam monasticam sibi eligere, L. Ecg. C. 20; Th. ii. 146, 23.
